meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Drive a change through a red-green-refactor loop - failing test first, minimal code to pass, then clean up. Use when implementing a feature or fixing a bug where correctness matters and a test can pin the behavior. Says "TDD", "test first", "red green refactor", "write the test first".

copy.tagline: 用红绿重构循环驱动功能开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写代码前习惯先写测试来锁定行为
copy.tagline_en: Drive feature development with red-green-refactor loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write tests before code to lock behavior

howto.what: Claude 会引导你通过红-绿-重构循环：先写一个会失败的测试，再写最少代码让测试通过，最后清理代码。每次只处理一小步，并展示每一步的测试结果。
howto.when: 当你要求实现一个功能或修复一个 bug，且该行为可以用测试来验证时触发。例如你说“用 TDD 实现一个函数”或“先写测试再写代码”。

say.text: 用 TDD 实现一个计算器加法功能。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个失败的测试，然后写代码让它通过。

say.text: 修复这个 bug，先写一个重现问题的测试。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a red-green-refactor loop: write a failing test, write minimal code to pass, then clean up. It works in small steps and shows each test result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement a feature or fix a bug where behavior can be pinned by a test. For example, saying "use TDD to implement a function" or "write the test first".

say_en.text: Implement a calculator add function using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test first, then code to pass.

say_en.text: Fix this bug, write a test that reproduces it first.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test to reproduce the bug, then fix the code.
